image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a large iguana's head and upper torso. The iguana has textured, greyish-green scales with a prominent circular subtympanic shield below the ear area. A row of spiky dorsal crest scales runs along the neck. The eye is visible but partially obscured by shadow/angle. The background is blurred, suggesting an enclosure or natural habitat.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a tight close-up on the head and shoulder region; the throat and dewlap are outside the frame or heavily occluded by the angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible eye appears dark/brownish rather than distinctly golden, and the pupil shape is difficult to verify as perfectly round due to lighting and resolution. The iris color does not clearly match the 'golden' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: A large circular subtympanic shield (scale) is present below the tympanum.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A very distinct, large, circular scale pattern is clearly visible on the side of the head, matching the description of the subtympanic shield perfectly.
The visible portion of the body behind the head appears thick and muscular, consistent with a robust build.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is greyish-green with darker shading, consistent with an adult iguana. While distinct black bands aren't fully visible in this crop, the base color matches the adult description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A clear row of pointed, spine-like scales is visible running down the back of the neck, forming the characteristic dorsal crest.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture shows a mix of smaller granular scales on the body and larger, irregular plate-like scales on the head and around the eye/shield area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The limbs are largely out of frame or occluded by the body angle; digits and claws are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in this close-up shot.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The circular scale pattern looks slightly too perfect and geometrically regular compared to the surrounding organic chaos of the other scales. It resembles a stamped pattern rather than natural biological variation, though it could be a specific species trait.

artifact_observations.location: Background and lower right limb area
artifact_observations.reasoning: Standard depth-of-field blur, but the transition between the sharp head and the blurred background has slight edge bleeding/haloing typical of AI generation or aggressive post-processing.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out look-alike lizards given the close-up nature.
To audit the boundary integrity of the suspiciously perfect circular scale and check for fusion artifacts between scales.
To assess general texture consistency and detect subtle generative artifacts in the skin texture.

focus_areas: Authenticity of the subtympanic shield pattern
Texture consistency between head plates and body granules
Edge definition between subject and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'subtympanic shield'. In real iguanas, this is a large scale, but AI often generates it as a perfectly circular, isolated object that doesn't integrate well with surrounding scales. Check if the expert topology audit reveals discontinuity here. Also, verify if the eye reflection and iris detail are biologically plausible or if they show 'glassy' AI artifacts.
